dedupe_keys.name: gsma mobile money metrics and mobile money deployment tracker

description: An interactive tool with global data on mobile money services. The GSMA page says Mobile Money Metrics combines data the programme has collected since 2009: global metrics on accounts, agents and usage from the annual Global Adoption Survey and country modelling, a Mobile Money Prevalence Index of adoption, activity and accessibility by country, a regulatory index, and the Mobile Money Deployment Tracker, which lists live services, is updated monthly and can be downloaded through the tool. Browsing is free. Coverage is global, mainly low and middle income countries. Caveats: the licence and terms of download are not stated on the pages read, and metrics include modelled estimates. For simulation it shows where mobile money is a main payment channel, so outages of mobile networks or power cut access to money, as in disasters. A related catalogue record is the MoMTSim synthetic mobile money transactions dataset.
